newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Tuskar Resources names managing director.
newsitem.headline: Tuskar Resources names managing director.

text.p: Irish exploration company Tuskar Resources said on Tuesday it had appointed Emmet Brown as managing director of the company with immediate effect.

Brown, a geologist by profession, has 25 years experience in the oil and gas exploration and production in Ireland. He is a former chief executive and managing director of Atlantic Resources and a former chairman of the Irish Offshore Operation Group, Tuskar said in a statement.
The company also said that Kase Lawal and Howard Wolf had been appointed to the board with immediate effect.
Wolf will assume the chairmanship of Tuskar within the next six months following the retirement of the current chairman, Duncan McGregor.
Both Wolf and Lawal have a beneficial interest in Allied Energy Limited which confirmed on Monday that it had a beneficial interest in 617,801,938 ordinary shares in Tuskar Resources.
It also holds warrants to subscribe for 50 million ordinary shares exercisable at any time up to December 31, 2000 at an exercise price of three Irish pence per share.

Tuskar's shares were readmitted to dealing on the Irish Stock Exchange on Monday following shareholder approval of the acquisition of a 40 percent working interest in oil mining lease OML 110 offshore Nigeria from the Camac/Allied group and completion of the deal.
